descriptions.notStarted: Oh...looks like Ludmilla is not quite done with me yet. I'd better head back and see what that nag wants now...
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Ludmilla, and big surprise---her Cherry Pie Ghoulash didn't lure Jonas out. I think he probably pushed a bookcase in front of the door to ensure he never sees her again, but that's just a theory. At any rate, it looks like now her prized jewelry has mysteriously disappeared. She thinks Sophilia's taken it, but I'm not sure if I buy that, seeing as how she's...not around to do that. I have to gather #b20 #t4031769#s#k and #b10 #t4031770#s#k and bring them back to her.  The woman complains way too much... sheesh.
descriptions.completed: I found Ludmilla's beloved jewelry for her.  In return she gave me a worn, but well-loved doll. It's seen better days, but it has charm. Someone is probably looking for this...
